title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 53 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 53)

content.study:
Section 53 — Interpretation

Section 53 defines a foreign award for Chapter II of Part II in the Geneva Convention framework, using the statutory requirements concerning commercial legal relationships, the relevant historical conventions, written arbitration agreement, date of award and reciprocal territory.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
